title: Late surge of bets has Sonny Styles favored to go No. 4 overall

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Late surge of bets has Sonny Styles favored to go No. 4 overall
sources.description: Throughout the pre-draft process, Notre Dame running back Jeremiyah Love has been widely expected to go to the Titans with the fourth overall pick in the draft.
